name: G.K. Consultants Limited
about: G.K. Consultants Limited operates as a non-banking financial company in India. It also engaged in the business of consultancy, share trading, investment, hiring of assets, software business, and other activities of a non-banking finance company. In addition, the company offers secured and unsecured loans and advances; investment and financial services; and retail and MSME financing, as well as personal loans, consumer finance, working capital loans, term loans, gold loans, and business loans. G.K. Consultants Limited was incorporated in 1988 and is headquartered in New Delhi, India.
